bit_order: MSB-first for all F12 header/block syntax; multi-byte checksum fields are written big-endian
header_order_after_prefix: compre U1 and conditional compr U8
mixmdate and conditional selected downmix fields
conditional JOC additional-BSI fields sourced from the same F13 container
exponent format, fixed AHT/SNR strategy/transient pre-noise flags and syntax mask
main frame codes or six-block fullband strategy

mixing_path.selected: present; source value from F06 preferred_downmix_mode

mixing_path.meaning: presence flag; zero suppresses the separate 5-bit lfemixlevcod field
presence flag; zero suppresses the separate 6-bit pgmscl field
presence flag; zero suppresses the separate 6-bit extpgmscl field
mixing option 1; no additional mixdef payload
presence flag; zero suppresses frame/block mixing configuration fields

information_path.meaning: presence flag; zero suppresses mixlevel U5, roomtyp U2, and adconvtyp U1

six_block_order: conditional short bits for five fullband lanes [L,C,R,Ls,Rs]
conditional dither bits for five fullband lanes
line DRC presence and conditional U8 code
all bandwidth codes for refreshed fullband lanes
LFE exponent body when the block LFE strategy is 1
fast-gain update and six lane codes
block0-only converter SNR presence/U10; other blocks presence 0
per-block EMDF skip presence when skip syntax is enabled
mantissa item groups and ungrouped codes

emdf_skip.syntax_enable: header syntax mask bit1 is set iff a published EMDF payload is present
emdf_skip.block_presence: only block2 present=1; other five block presence bits=0 when syntax is enabled
emdf_skip.length: U9 byte count of the complete F13 EMDF container C, 0..511
emdf_skip.payload: write the complete container bytes once at the current MSB bit cursor; no external FFmpeg skip-field patch
emdf_skip.absent_source: sources0/1 pass ABSENT_PUBLISHED_PAYLOAD_V1; skip syntax is absent and payload fields are not validated, but F12 still builds the full 4096-byte source frame and E-AC-3 CRC16

frame_budget.writer_rule: candidate fits only if all header, six-block syntax, BSI, and EMDF carrier fields end by bit32734

candidate_plan_boundary.search: F12S.8 main q search and converter plan are separate; fixed frame/input plan is reused for all trials
candidate_plan_boundary.trial_recomputes: wire/quantization candidate serialization only per approved F12 trial contract
candidate_plan_boundary.success_state: staged F12 state proposal; outer source transaction governs commit
